instruction: Enable both auto-save and backup copy creation in LibreOffice Impress for comprehensive data protection

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling both auto-save and backup copy. The evaluator checks both AutoSave and CreateBackup properties, awarding 0.5 points for each correct setting (total 1.0 for both correct).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct auto-save setting, 0.5 for correct backup copy setting

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both requirements (auto-save AND backup copy creation)
Correct state extraction: Getter retrieves the correct LibreOffice config file from standard path (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu)

Correct metric logic: Parses XML correctly with proper namespace handling, searches for correct XML path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document), and checks the right properties (AutoSave and CreateBackup)
Appropriate scoring: 0.5 points per setting = 1.0 total for both correct, matching instruction requirements for partial credit
Correct expected values: Both autosave_enabled and backup_enabled set to true, semantically matching instruction to enable both features
Robust edge case handling: Handles XML parsing errors, missing files, and None values gracefully
No postconfig needed: Settings are persisted to disk when changed in LibreOffice preferences, so file retrieval after task completion is sufficient
